en.title: Saudi foreign minister co-chairs high-level meeting on Palestinian peace process in New York
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan co-chaired a meeting with France, the United Kingdom, and Canada in New York focused on Palestinian peace efforts and a comprehensive Gaza peace plan. He urged countries that have not yet done so to recognize the State of Palestine.

stories.title: ‎UCA sees negative impact on 2026 results after suspension of policy issuance

en.title: UCA sees negative impact on 2026 results after suspension of policy issuance
en.summary: United Cooperative Assurance expects its 2026 financial results to be negatively affected by the Insurance Authority's suspension of policy issuance and renewals across all insurance products. The company stated it cannot yet quantify the impact but will work with regulators on corrective measures.
